title: Figure 21: SEM of a 1141-electrode array for the human brain surface (University of Utah)
description: Scanning electron micrograph of a hexagonal block densely covered with hundreds of fine needle electrodes, with a "200µm" scale bar. The caption reads "Figure 21. Scanning Electron Micrograph of a 1141 Electrode Array Made to Be Inserted Into the Surface of the Human Brain (University of Utah)." It appears under the heading "Brain-Machine Interfaces."
